name: Centered Hero Headline
description: Full-canvas dim overlay (~50% strength) with one big centered all-caps headline. No subtitle banner, no accent rule. Works for hype-style channels — true-crime storytelling, motivation, breaking-news takes — where the title needs to dominate and the portrait is supporting context.
composition_guidance: Build a single emotionally legible hero scene with a full-canvas dim overlay and one large centered title; the scene supports the words rather than competing with them.
required_elements: one large centered all-caps episode headline
headline_guidance: Render the exact episode title as one big centered all-caps headline.
visual_style_guidance: Use a clear background scene with a full black dim overlay around fifty percent strength; keep the large warm-yellow centered headline dominant.
